description: Kafka topic topology for Pulse Engine - Capability Event Pipeline architecture

topics.name: pulse.checkout.completed.v1
topics.description: Main entry event from Kogito BPMN after checkout process completes (Process + Decision capabilities)

topics.name: pulse.decision.completed.v1
topics.description: Decision result produced by Pulse Engine (Decide capability)

topics.name: pulse.insight.generated.v1
topics.description: Final insight event published by Engine after all capabilities complete (Explain capability)

topics.name: pulse.checkout.retry.v1
topics.description: Retry queue for transient failures with exponential backoff (max 3 retries)

topics.name: pulse.checkout.completed.v1.dlq
topics.description: Dead letter queue for pulse.checkout.completed.v1 after exhausted retries

topics.name: pulse.decision.completed.v1.dlq
topics.description: Dead letter queue for pulse.decision.completed.v1 after exhausted retries

topics.name: pulse.insight.generated.v1.dlq
topics.description: Dead letter queue for pulse.insight.generated.v1 after exhausted retries
